attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: article_publishing
steps:
  - id: fetch_article_draft
    op: api_call
    params:
      endpoint: content_management_api/drafts
      method: GET
      description: Fetch the article draft from the content management API
    output: article_draft

  - id: validate_draft
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{article_draft}}"
      schema: article_schema
      description: Validate the draft against the article schema
    output: validation_result

  - id: authenticate_publishing_service
    op: authenticate
    params:
      service: publishing_service
      method: service_credentials
      description: Authenticate as the publishing service before publishing
    output: auth_token

  - id: publish_article
    op: api_call
    params:
      endpoint: content_management_api/articles
      method: POST
      body: "{{article_draft}}"
      authorization: "Bearer {{auth_token}}"
      description: Publish the validated article to the content management system
    depends_on:
      - validate_draft
      - authenticate_publishing_service
    output: publish_result
